title: Prime Minister greets Herath Poshte to Kashmiri Pandit Community
content:
Press Release:Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister greets Herath Poshte to Kashmiri Pandit Community Posted On:
                15 FEB 2026 8:30AM by PIB Delhi The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi greeted Herath Poshte, the sacred festival reflecting the rich traditions of  Kashmiri Pandit community.  “On this pious occasion, I pray for wellness and abundance in everyone’s lives. May it open new pathways of success and fill every home with joy and contentment”, Shri Modi said. The Prime Minister posted on X: “Herath Poshte! This sacred festival reflects the rich traditions of our Kashmiri Pandit community. On this pious occasion, I pray for wellness and abundance in everyone’s lives. May it open new pathways of success and fill every home with joy and contentment.” Herath Poshte! This sacred festival reflects the rich traditions of our Kashmiri Pandit community.
